method: Windows System.IO.Compression.ZipFile into a new explicit outside-repository directory. Verify equal member counts, unique separator-normalized relative paths, exact byte lengths and SHA256 of every decompressed member against its source. No extraction, deletion or overwrite.
initial_verification_error: The first ZIP used Windows backslashes in member names; direct forward-slash GetEntry lookup failed. The archive was preserved unchanged. Verification normalized both sides, rejected duplicate normalized paths and checked every member successfully. No content/hash mismatch was found.
protected_mapping: Preserved only as opaque archive bytes and hashes; condition mapping was not deserialized or revealed. Archives and all speaker material remain private and outside Git.
human_review_at_snapshot: 100 fixed blank records, zero genuine ratings; future WORKING.csv changes are not included in this snapshot.
limitations: Same-volume preservation protects against accidental local edits, not disk/site loss. Model weights/runtime remain separate hash-bound assets. No claim of automatic future annotation backup or remote research preservation.
